name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-library-quick-links
title: Library Quick Links Web Part
shortDescription: Display SharePoint document libraries as tiles or a list with configurable sorting, library visibility, optional metadata, and a search and filter header. Uses the current SharePoint theme.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework (SPFx) web part that displays document libraries from the current SharePoint site in responsive Tiles or List layouts, using the current SharePoint theme.

Sort libraries alphabetically or by last item-modified date in ascending or descending order. Hide libraries by name; Shared Documents is hidden by default and can be displayed by removing its entry from the hide setting.

Optional metadata shows library descriptions, separate file and folder icons and counts, current file sizes in both MB and GB, and the last item-modified date. Metadata tiles use cards, while the list uses compact rows.
An optional header, hidden by default, provides search by library name or description, a result count, and metadata filters for all libraries, libraries with files, or libraries with no files.

Uses authenticated SharePoint REST requests with pagination and respects the current user's access without requiring Microsoft Graph permissions. Supports SharePoint pages, SharePoint full-page apps, Microsoft Teams tabs, and Teams personal apps.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page. Client-side web parts can be deployed to SharePoint environments that support the SharePoint Framework. You can also use modern JavaScript web frameworks, tools, and libraries to build them.
